ns2:course.label: Food & Industrial Microbiology
ns2:course.description: Relationship of microorganisms to food manufacture and preservation, to food and industrial fermentation and processing, and to food-borne illness. Same as MCB 434. Prerequisite: MCB 101 or MCB 301 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as MCB 434. Prerequisite: MCB 101 or MCB 301 or equivalent.
